verify.body: This keeps fake requests out. It takes about 30 seconds and costs nothing.
verify.expired: The link expired. Tap the button again.
verify.inPerson: Verify in person (at a campus drive or with a volunteer)
verify.inPersonNotice: When you call, the verifier's phone shows your number. They delete it from their call list afterwards.
verify.inPersonSteps: 1. Show this code to an UDVASITO admin or volunteer. 2. When they ask, call their phone — they will reject the call, so it costs nothing. 3. They confirm, and your number is verified.
verify.laterNote: You can still post a request now. Until you verify, you can have 1 open request and donors will see "phone not yet verified".
verify.mismatch: Telegram shared {{verified}}, which is different from {{entered}}. Use {{verified}} as your number?
verify.telegramSteps: 1. Tap the button — Telegram opens. 2. Tap Start, then "Share my phone number". 3. Come back here.
verify.title: Verify your mobile number
verify.whatsappSteps: 1. Tap the button — WhatsApp opens with a message ready. 2. Tap Send. 3. Come back here.

welcome.ai: How AI is used: when you type or paste a request, the text (with phone numbers, names and illnesses removed) may be processed by an AI service to fill the form. You always check it before posting. AI never decides who is contacted.
welcome.consent: I am 18 or older and I agree to the Terms and Privacy notice.
welcome.permissions: Permissions we may ask for, only when you use the feature: Location — to find where blood is needed or your area (we never store your live location). Notifications — to alert donors and update you. Microphone — to speak a request. Camera/Photos — to attach a hospital slip.
welcome.privacy: Privacy notice — what we collect and why
welcome.title: Welcome to UDVASITO
welcome.voice: Voice: your phone's or browser's own speech service turns your voice into text (this may be Google's service). UDVASITO never receives your audio.
